Columbina Hyposelenia is a playable Hydro character in Genshin Impact.

Known as the Moon Goddess of Nod-Krai, Kuutar to the Frostmoon Scions, and formerly The Damselette, Third of the Fatui Harbingers, she was born into an unkind world and cast into solitude from the moment of her creation. Once a wanderer of looping paths and fading memories, she found her identity through the bonds she formed and the quiet hopes she claimed as her own. Though she bears many names, to those closest to her she is Columbina Hyposelenia—and she prefers it that way.

Awaken Moonbound Tides, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and summoning Gravity RippleGravity RippleAfter unleashing Elemental Skill Eternal Tides, Columbina will summon Gravity Ripple.
Gravity Ripple will follow the current active character on the field, while continuously dealing AoE Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents.

Additionally, while Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will gain the New Moon's Omen effect for 2s, continuously accumulating Gravity. 20 Gravity can be accumulated every 2s.
You can have up to 60 Gravity, and it will be removed when the duration of Gravity Ripple ends.
Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, a special Gravity Interference will be triggered. Different effects will be triggered depending on the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina. If the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
    • Lunar-Charged: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Electro AoE DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
    • Lunar-Bloom: Gravity Interference will fire 5 Moondew Sigils at surrounding opponents, dealing Dendro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.
    • Lunar-Crystallize: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Geo AoE DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Crystallize DMG.

Moonlight, Lent Unto You
Moonsign Benediction Passive
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged, Bloom, or Hydro-Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into a Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or Lunar-Crystallize reaction respectively. Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by party members gain a Base DMG increase based on Columbina's Max HP. For every 1,000 points of Max HP, the Base DMG of Lunar reactions is increased by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 7%.

Additionally, when Columbina is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
Lunar Vigil
Utility Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes

If one of your party members is incapacitated while in the Nod-Krai or Frost Moon regions, Columbina will revive this character. The amount of HP the character will have upon revival is based on Columbina's Friendship Level. This effect can occur once every 100s. This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
Additionally, Columbina appears to have a special affinity for certain animals who are influenced by kuuvahki...

  • Columbina must be in the active party and alive for this passive's effects to work. This applies to both the revival effect and the wildlife-related effects.
  • If Columbina is the active character and is incapacitated while this passive is not on cooldown, she will revive herself.
  • If a party member is incapacitated while this passive is on cooldown or unavailable, the revival will not activate even after this passive is available again.
  • Like with Lauma's utility passive, certain wildlife will behave differently if Columbina is in the party. This only applies in Nod-Krai, and will not work on the same creatures in other regions.
    • Some creatures will have special interactions. A glowing symbol will briefly appear above them when approached.
      • Blunthorn Rhino - These mine and retrieve nearby Rainbowdrop Crystals.
      • Chic Badger - These dig up Fowl and Raw Meat (amount varies).
      • Puffin - These follow the party around.
      • Rimehorn Deer - These heal the party and fully fill their Energy meters.
    • Wildlife in the "Other" category will not startle when approached.
    • Pale-Furred Wolves will not attack when approached. However, they will do so if the player enters combat or stays near them for more than a few minutes.
    • Unlocks exclusive dialogue with certain animal NPCs, such as Pavlov at the Lucky Spin minigame, the finch beside Richeza at the Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse, and the guard animals near Lyylikki.
  • The following Talents are similar to this talent:
    • Other Wildlife:
      • Prayers for the Forest (Lauma)
      • Tailing on Tiptoes (Yaoyao)
      • Thought and Intent, Like Silken Scent (Lan Yan)
      • Yoohoo Art: Silencer's Secret (Sayu)
